Morgan Lee: Heads-up — nightly invoice reconciliation shows 58 customers with duplicate NetSuite credit memos tied to refunds. Stripe only shows one refund per customer.
Sasha Patel: duplicate only in NetSuite? any timing pattern?
Morgan Lee: yes. All duplicates created in a ~30m window after our billing worker spike. Example: Stripe refund rf_00xZ -> NS CM-7810 and CM-7811.
Kai (eng): did we push anything to the billing stack recently?
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-09-03-02:10 by @Kai
Kai (eng): we did deploy a small tracing change to add an "X-Received-Ts" header at the gateway for observability. Intended to be opaque.
Sasha Patel: could that header affect idempotency?
Kai (eng): it turned out our idempotency generator was hashing the entire incoming request object (headers + body) including transient tracing headers. When webhooks get retried by the queue later, the gateway rewrites that header with a new timestamp and the hash changes, so the system reprocesses the same event.
Morgan Lee: logs: 
```
WARN billing:webhook - verification ok for evt_00xZ
INFO billing:processor - created credit_memo CM-7810 for refund rf_00xZ
INFO billing:replay - re-enqueued evt_00xZ due to worker backoff attempt=1
INFO billing:processor - created credit_memo CM-7811 for refund rf_00xZ (replayed)
DEBUG billing:idempotency - computed_key_original=sha1:abcd1234 includes header X-Received-Ts=169....
DEBUG billing:idempotency - computed_key_replay=sha1:efgh5678 includes header X-Received-Ts=170....
```
Sasha Patel: ugh. So root cause = idempotency keyed on non-deterministic headers (X-Received-Ts). Fixes?
Kai (eng): immediate fixes: 1) stop including any ephemeral/tracing headers in idempotency hash; 2) explicitly compute idempotency from stable fields (stripe_event_id + refund_id + amount) only; 3) short-term: have the gateway stop overwriting X-Received-Ts for enqueued replays.
Morgan Lee: remediation: can we auto-void the later credit memo where external_ref (refund id) + amount match and created within 20m? ~58 accounts affected. Need finance approval to auto-void and add audit notes.
finance-approvals: Please provide scope and rollback plan.
Sasha Patel: scope = 58 NetSuite credit memos. Rollback: we will unvoid and attach a reversal audit note if any issues. Backfill will be a dry-run first and we'll post the list.
Kai (eng): I've opened PR to change idempotency logic and added unit tests to ensure transient headers are filtered. Also pushed a gateway patch to preserve X-Received-Ts for replayed messages at 1777778100. Monitoring now.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-20456 created: "Ephemeral header included in idempotency -> duplicate NetSuite credit memos" assigned to Kai, priority P1
Sasha Patel: approved for automated voids up to 100 accounts pending dry-run results. Please run dry-run and post to #finance-updates.
Morgan Lee: scheduling dry-run at 1777778600; actual backfill scheduled at 1777779300 after hotfix verification. Will post results. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
